Bank Reconciliation

The bank reconciliation view displays a detailed comparison between your bank statement balance and your accounting records.

This view helps you identify and track transactions that haven't cleared your bank account yet.

Key Information Displayed

The reconciliation shows your closing balance as per bank statement, which is the ending balance shown on your bank statement for the selected date.

Pending deposits are receipts or transfers that you've recorded but haven't appeared on your bank statement yet.

Pending withdrawals are payments or transfers that you've recorded but haven't cleared through your bank account.

Reconciliation Status

The view calculates the adjusted closing balance by adding pending deposits and subtracting pending withdrawals from your bank statement balance.

This adjusted balance is compared to your closing balance as per balance sheet to determine if there's a discrepancy.

If the discrepancy is zero, your reconciliation shows as Reconciled. Otherwise, it displays Not Reconciled with the discrepancy amount.

To create or edit reconciliations, see: Bank Reconciliation — Edit
